sources.entry: Datasette - Explore and publish data with easy import and export and database management. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: Datasette is an open source tool for exploring and publishing data, turning SQLite databases into interactive websites with an accompanying API.
summary.what_it_does: Datasette takes data of any shape or size and publishes it as an explorable web interface and API. You run it against SQLite database files with a single command, which starts a local web server (port 8001 by default) for browsing the data. A metadata.json file can add title, license and source information that appears on the index page, footer and API output. The README also describes a publish subcommand that packages the app and databases into a Docker image and deploys it to Heroku or Google Cloud Run. Datasette Lite runs the project in the browser via WebAssembly without a Python server.
use_cases: explore a SQLite database in a web browser
publish a dataset as an interactive website with an API
browse personal data such as browser history or downloads
add license and source attribution to a published dataset
deploy SQLite databases to Heroku or Google Cloud Run
run a data exploration tool in the browser without a server
notable: Browse-and-API publishing of SQLite databases with one command
metadata.json adds licensing and source info to the site and API
Datasette Lite runs entirely in the browser via WebAssembly
Can open non-Datasette SQLite files such as a Chrome history database with --nolock
caveats: Requires Python 3.11 or higher when installed with pip
The publish command needs Heroku or Google Cloud Run configured
